scenes.text: Seventeen degrees. Sixty two percent. Fourteen kilometres an hour. Every forecast gives you numbers.
Meet Halcyon. It tells you how the day will actually feel.
A crisp morning, then a warm afternoon. Bring a light jacket, and leave the umbrella at home.
When rain is on its way, Halcyon tells you when to leave. Head out by four fifteen, and you'll stay dry.
Your whole week, in plain words. Bright on Monday. Breezy on Tuesday. Soft rain by Thursday.
Halcyon. Weather, in plain words. Coming to iPhone this spring.
